title: Quickfire compliance scrap (Lina)
body:
Morning dump — brain dump for the next sprint on SOC2 evidence and the quick vendor reviews.

Top priorities (today):
- Finish evidence bundle for CC-3 (change management) — need screenshots from staging deploy pipeline + ticket list.
- Short vendor decision notes for VaultCorp and CipherStor: who has KMS integration? confirm with Miguel.
- Tidy up access attestation template and send to legal for language check.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Which staging pipeline run (date/run-id) do we prefer to cite for CC-3? I think 2026-02-28 run is the most complete but need the logs (artifact id).
- CipherStor SRA: do they rotate keys monthly by default or is that enterprise-only? (ticketed vendor question).
- Are we allowed to share redacted user lists as evidence for LC-2? check with privacy.

Quick evidence checklist (scratch order, not final):
1) CC-3 change approvals:
   - PRs linked: GH-PR-9801, GH-PR-9845, GH-PR-9890 (need signed-off diff screenshots)
   - Pipeline run logs: pipeline-2026-02-28-build-57 (grab raw log + screenshot)
   - Change review board minutes: conv-2026-03-02 (search slack thread)
2) AC-2 user lifecycle:
   - Onboarding spreadsheet export: users-2026-03.csv (generate from admin portal)
   - Deprovisioning ticket list: JIRA-OPS-2211, JIRA-OPS-2304
3) LC-2 data handling note:
   - Draft policy v0.4 attached? (need legal review)
4) Vendor evidence for KMS/HSM:
   - VaultCorp: cert? need attestation PDF and API key rotation policy
   - CipherStor: confirm SLA and FIPS status

Action items (me):
- [ ] Pull raw pipeline logs for 2026-02-28 (temp: /tmp/pipeline-logs) — due EOD today
- [ ] Ping Miguel about CipherStor key rotation and ask for sample cert chain — due tomorrow
- [ ] Draft short vendor-risk paragraph for upcoming review deck (2-3 bullets)
- [ ] Update access attestation template and circulate to legal (PR to GH-PR-9912)

Notes to self / reminders:
- When creating evidence bundle, include a small README.md that explains what each file is and why it satisfies the control — reviewers appreciate the guide. Keep README < 1 page.
- Use screenshots with redaction overlay rather than cropping to preserve timestamps.
- For anything from third parties, always capture an authoritative URL + date accessed.

Tiny vendor review snippets (raw):
- VaultCorp: good docs, supports AWS KMS + GCP KMS. Pricing looks ok for now. Need their attestation and key rotation frequency. Security contact: security@vaultcorp.example (ask for SOC2 or ISO27001 doc).
- CipherStor: lean on-prem friendly vendor. FIPS claim in marketing — verify with cert number. Older API version might not support automatic rotation without paid plan. Ask sales for paid plan feature matrix.

Meeting prep items for 2026-03-22 sprint check-in:
- 5m summary of evidence gaps (top 3)
- 10m vendor decisions (VaultCorp vs CipherStor short pros/cons)
- 5m ask: legal to sign off on attestation wording

Random fragments / ideas:
- Could we automate a small script that zips the evidence and generates a checklist file with SHA256 of each artifact? Might be handy for reviewers and tamper-evidence. Save as tech debt ticket if not now.
- Consider a simple internal playbook for "what to attach for X control" — one-paragraph per control.

Reference links I might need to copy into final doc:
- Confluence control matrix (linked above)
- Vendor contract bucket (shared drive link above)
- Recent PR that changed deprovisioning flow: GH-PR-9845

End of dump. Will convert to proper checklist after lunch and assign owners.

-- Lina
